original_test_intent: Inject one approved deferred poison on the intended AMD GPU, observe bounded poison consumption/Bus error, decode a fresh Uncorrected Non-fatal MCE record, and prove the host and unaffected GPU state recover without fatal escalation.
original_method: Resolve component and target semantics; map device2 to UUID/BDF/OAM/socket; use an owner-approved disposable allocation/process; baseline device2 decode/log/poison state; inject block2/type8 once; capture logical-to-physical/VMID provenance and scoped Bus error; decode the fresh record against table6.4; confirm non-fatal containment, clear/recover poison and validate data/GPU/host health.
manual_activity: The GPU RAS owner resolves the component and target, approves a disposable poison allocation/process and clear/recovery mechanism, supervises one injection and judges containment plus decoded evidence.
required_inputs: Approved amdgpuras build/version/checksum and AMD GPU RAS guide table6.4 full schema
Decision whether block2 target matches the SDMA-named Script and proof type8 means deferred non-fatal poison
Stable device2 UUID/BDF/OAM/socket mapping and explanation of device0 UMC baseline relevance
Disposable allocation/process/workload, logical/physical address and VMID ownership plus data-integrity boundaries
Expected complete Uncorrected Non-fatal/MCE decoded fields beyond the truncated source sample
Poison consumption, Bus error scope, fatal-escalation abort, clear/recovery/reboot and restoration criteria
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle accelerator/host with disposable verified data and independent console/OOB
Never poison an unknown or shared allocation; confirm process, VMID and address ownership before injection
Do not reload shared amdgpu or clear evidence without approval; capture device2 preexisting records
Inject once; abort on wrong address/VMID/device, unrelated process impact, fatal severity, reset, hang or lost evidence
No retry; preserve first event and use owner-approved poison clear/page/process/GPU/host recovery
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool/guide, component/type, UUID/BDF target, allocation/VMID/address ownership and recovery readiness
After separate approval, collect exact one-shot, Bus error scope, full decode and persistent evidence
Do not select memory/address/process, assume device2 stability, reload driver, inject, consume poison broadly, clear, retry, reset/reboot, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve source component/baseline/schema gaps and approve target tuple
Provide safe allocation/VMID/address and bounded Bus error oracle
Supervise single deferred-poison event and containment
Clear/recover poison, validate data/GPU/host and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It captures poison/decode generally but omits the literal tuple and unsafe address/process implications while adding unrelated RAS categories.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after allocation and target approval, run the explicit mapped equivalent of block2/type8/device2 once and decode device2; bind returned addresses/VMID to the disposable allocation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: modprobe, device0 UMC query, block2/type8/device2 injection, device2 decode, Bus error example, table6.4, truncated JSON, SDMA Script and 30/30-minute scope remain preserved as source inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inject one poison into a verified disposable device2 allocation, prove scoped non-fatal consumption and a fresh full table6.4 decode, then clear/recover and validate data/GPU/host health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds allocation/VMID/address ownership, full schema, fatal-escalation gates and poison lifecycle recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Bus error and partial JSON header do not prove safe non-fatal containment or that the decoded record belongs to the intended allocation/device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Poison may surface asynchronously in a different process or after the nominal command, complicating attribution and cleanup.

project_override_considerations: Sample logical/physical addresses, VMID3, timestamp and record_id are dynamic evidence, not reusable targets. The project must reconcile the SDMA Script name with block2 architecture and supply the complete table6.4 field contract.
expected_evidence: Resolved component/type semantics, tool/guide provenance and full table6.4 schema
UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/device2 plus disposable process/allocation/VMID/address ownership and data hash
Device2 pre-decode cursor, poison/page state, logs and persistent/OOB baseline
Exact one-shot transcript with returned logical/physical address/VMID and correctly scoped Bus error
Fresh complete Uncorrected Non-fatal/MCE decode and target-correlated firmware/OS/BMC evidence with no fatal escalation
Poison clear/recovery, process/data/GPU/host health, restoration diff and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure baselines device0 UMC but injects/decodes device2 block2, while the Script name says SDMA. The Criteria's JSON example ends after sec_count, so the required record body and target/location fields are incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Deferred non-fatal poison purpose and candidate tuple are identifiable. Engineering can provide the allocation, component mapping and full schema before execution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row120 Wistron-GPU RAS-00021-V003: prove block2/type8/device2 implements the intended deferred non-fatal poison and reconcile the SDMA Script name; explain device0 UMC baseline or replace with device2 freshness; provide disposable process/allocation with logical/physical/VMID provenance; complete table6.4 decoded fields; define Bus error scope, non-fatal/no-reset oracle, poison clear/recovery, data/GPU/host health, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds poison allocation ownership, asynchronous containment and cleanup while identifying component, cross-device baseline and truncated-schema gaps missed earlier.
independent_technical_reasoning: Deferred poison is dangerous because failure may occur on later consumption rather than at injection. The returned addresses and VMID must belong to a disposable process, and the Bus error must be limited to that consumer. A header-only non-fatal JSON sample and unrelated device0 UMC count cannot prove device2 record freshness or safe recovery.
